label: copy phase: echoed x whose next output is v (x->v bigram), not at sequence start
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase, almost entirely (97% of mass) on steps where the fed-back input is x. The strongest activations come when that x is followed by v in the original (the model must now output v), especially in x v v runs, e.g. c h o [x] v v u i. It is silent when the x is original token 0 or 1 (recall_idx < 2), and silent everywhere in the original and delimiter phases. A weak tail (about 26% of mass, mostly the lowest quartile) fires on copy-phase x inputs followed by other tokens (x, c, digits), and occasionally on v inputs that precede v. Precision of x->v with recall_idx>=2 is 0.86 (0.97 if recall_idx>=3), but recall is only about 0.52 because of that weak tail.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues.
